name: invalid_objects_report
description: Generate an HTML report of invalid Oracle objects.

arguments.name: connection
arguments.description: Oracle connection with IP, PORT (1-65535) and SID.

arguments.name: schemas
arguments.description: Schemas to check, keyed by schema name, each an object (or a JSON string of one) with username and password.

arguments.name: report
arguments.description: Report file naming: add_text (boolean), position ('before' or 'after') and text added to the HTML file name; nothing is added when omitted.

arguments.name: sqlhome
arguments.description: Oracle home whose bin/sqlplus is used; sqlplus is taken from PATH when omitted.

outputs.name: report
outputs.description: Path to the generated HTML report.

outputs.name: connection
outputs.description: Connection checked: host, port and sid.

outputs.name: clean
outputs.description: Number of schemas with no invalid objects.

outputs.name: attention_required
outputs.description: Number of schemas with invalid objects.

outputs.name: errors
outputs.description: Number of schemas whose check failed.

outputs.name: invalid_objects
outputs.description: Total number of invalid objects found.
